text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing standing prohibition on the west side of Grangeway Avenue be extended. The proposed amendments will deter parking near the access for 68 Grangeway Avenue and will improve the sightlines of vehicles traveling northbound on Grangeway Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Amended the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Grangeway Avenue, between a point 132 metres north of Ellesmere Road and a point 46 metres further north, be amended to be in effect between a point 113 metres north of Ellesmere Road and a point 65 metres further north.
